After paying $300 I'd have $140, and unmortgaging Oriental would eat most of that, leaving little for houses on the light blues even though a hotel there could be strong. Checking the other players, p3 has $1059 with no monopolies and p2 has $584 also without monopolies, so I'm weighing how much risk I can afford.

p1 is holding oranges with houses — NY at 3 houses ($500), St James down to 2 after selling one, Tennessee around 2 houses — and seems close to bankruptcy, which could hand me Oriental for free if they go under to me specifically rather than the bank or another player. Giving p1 the $300 risks letting them rebuild their oranges into a threat, so I'm leaning toward countering at $275 and only accepting the full $300 if they hold firm, since the light blue monopoly with houses is valuable enough to be patient over.
